+class ConditionalI18nExtension(Extension):
+    """Adds a ``{% ctrans %}`` tag that renders a translation only when a
+    runtime condition holds, and a fixed fallback text otherwise.
+
+    .. code-block:: html+jinja
+
+        {% ctrans use_i18n, count=items|length %}
+            {{ count }} item
+        {% pluralize %}
+            {{ count }} items
+        {% fallback %}
+            Items: {{ count }}
+        {% endctrans %}
+
+    The condition is a normal expression.  When it is true the block
+    is translated with ``gettext`` or, with a ``pluralize`` section,
+    ``ngettext`` exactly like ``{% trans %}``; when it is false the
+    ``fallback`` section is rendered as it is written, with only the
+    variables substituted.  The ``fallback`` section is required and
+    comes last.  Commas in the header are optional, and ``trimmed`` or
+    ``notrimmed`` applies to every section, the fallback included.
+
+    This extension reuses the ``gettext`` and ``ngettext`` functions of
+    the :class:`InternationalizationExtension`, so load both.
+    """
+
+    tags = {"ctrans"}
+
+    def parse(self, parser: "Parser") -> t.Union[nodes.Node, t.List[nodes.Node]]:
+        """Parse a conditional translatable tag."""
+        lineno = next(parser.stream).lineno
+        num_called_num = False
+
+        parser.stream.skip_if("comma")
+        condition = parser.parse_expression()
+
+        # Find all the variables referenced.  Like in the trans tag, a
+        # variable can also be defined in the body, which is checked at
+        # a later stage.  Commas between the parts are optional.
+        plural_expr: t.Optional[nodes.Expr] = None
+        plural_expr_assignment: t.Optional[nodes.Assign] = None
+        variables: t.Dict[str, nodes.Expr] = {}
+        trimmed = None
+        while parser.stream.
